question: What does MIL-STD-461 require for emission and susceptibility testing of electronic equipment?
answer:
Based on MIL-STD-461, the standard specifies the following requirements for emission and susceptibility testing of electronic, electrical, and electromechanical equipment:

### 1. Scope and General Requirements
* **Purpose**: Requirements are established to ensure interference control is incorporated into equipment design and to enable compatible operation in a complex electromagnetic environment (MIL-STD-461, Section 1. SCOPE, p. 6).
* **Applicability & Interoperability**: MIL-STD-461 is applied to general or multi-Service procurements and is used in conjunction with MIL-STD-462 and MIL-STD-463 (MIL-STD-461, Section 1. SCOPE, p. 6).

---

### 2. Transmitter Emission Limits (Key-Up Mode)
* **Narrowband Emissions**: Limited to $34\text{ dB}\mu\text{V}$ (MIL-STD-461, Section 6.3.2 Transmitters (Key-up mode.).-, p. 17–18).
* **Broadband Emissions**: Limited to $40\text{ dB}\mu\text{V/MHz}$ (MIL-STD-461, Section 6.3.2 Transmitters (Key-up mode.).-, p. 17–18).
* **Harmonics and Spurious Emissions**: Absolute peak powers shall not exceed the values in Figure 16 (excluding the test sample's designed emission bandwidth or $\pm 5\%$ of $f_0$) (MIL-STD-461, Section 6.3.2 Transmitters (Key-up mode.).-, p. 17–18).

---

### 3. Conducted Susceptibility (CS) Requirements
* **CS01 ($30\text{ Hz}$ to $50\text{ kHz}$)**: Class I equipment performance shall not degrade beyond specified tolerances when injected on power leads with electromagnetic energy up to the levels in Figure 17 (or if test voltages cannot be generated by $50\text{ W}$ dissipated into a $0.5\,\Omega$ load) (MIL-STD-461, Section 6.3.2 Transmitters (Key-up mode.).-, p. 17–18).
* **CS02 ($50\text{ kHz}$ to $400\text{ MHz}$)**: Performance shall not degrade beyond tolerances when subjected to $1\text{ V}$ from a $50\,\Omega$ source applied to power input terminals (excluding power cable). Equipment is considered non-susceptible if a $1\text{ W}$ source of $50\,\Omega$ impedance cannot develop the required voltage (MIL-STD-461, Section 6.3.2 Transmitters (Key-up mode.).-, p. 17–18).
* **CS03 ($30\text{ Hz}$ to $10\text{ GHz}$)**: Intermodulation products from two signals shall not be present when both signal generators are set $66\text{ dB}$ above the level required for standard reference output (MIL-STD-461, Section 6.3.2 Transmitters (Key-up mode.).-, p. 17–18).
* **CS05 (Cross-Modulation)**: Equipment shall not exhibit malfunction or performance degradation beyond tolerances when subjected to Signal Generator 2 set $66\text{ dB}$ above reference level (MIL-STD-461, Section 6.3.2 Transmitters (Key-up mode.).-, p. 17–18).
* **CS06 (Spike Injection)**: Equipment shall not exhibit malfunction or degradation when specified spikes (Figure 19) are applied to AC or DC power input lines (MIL-STD-461, Section 6.3.2 Transmitters (Key-up mode.).-, p. 17–18).
* **(T) CS07**: Involves squelch threshold adjustment tests using a second impulse signal of $50\text{ dB}\mu\text{V/MHz}$ (MIL-STD-461, Section 6.10 Limits for (T) CS07.-, p. 18).

---

### 4. Radiated Emission (RE) Requirements
* **RE01 ($30\text{ Hz}$ to $30\text{ kHz}$)**: Magnetic field emissions shall not exceed specified limits (MIL-STD-461, Section 6.10 Limits for (T) CS07.-, p. 18).
* **RE02 ($14\text{ kHz}$ to $10\text{ GHz}$)**: 
  * Narrowband E-field emissions shall not exceed Figure 21 limits (MIL-STD-461, Section 6.12 Limits for RE02.-, p. 18).
  * Broadband E-field emissions (except electric hand tools) shall not exceed Figure 22 limits (MIL-STD-461, Section 6.12 Limits for RE02.-, p. 18).
  * Between $25\text{ MHz}$ and $200\text{ MHz}$, limits must be met for both horizontally and vertically polarized waves (MIL-STD-461, Section 6.12 Limits for RE02.-, p. 18).
* **RE03**: Radiated harmonics and spurious emissions peak power shall not exceed Figure 16 (MIL-STD-461, Section 6.12 Limits for RE02.-, p. 18).
* **(T) RE04 ($20\text{ Hz}$ to $50\text{ kHz}$)**: Radiated magnetic field emissions shall not exceed Figure 23 limits (MIL-STD-461, Section 6.12 Limits for RE02.-, p. 18).
* **RE05 ($0.15\text{ MHz}$ to $1000\text{ MHz}$)**: Broadband emissions shall not exceed defined limits (relaxed by $20\text{ dB}$ for Class IIIC items from $0.15$ to $400\text{ MHz}$) (MIL-STD-461, Section 6.12 Limits for RE02.-, p. 18).
* **RE06**: Overhead power line emissions shall not exceed Figure 24 values for applicable weather conditions (MIL-STD-461, Section 6.12 Limits for RE02.-, p. 18).

---

### 5. Radiated Susceptibility (RS) Requirements
* **RS01 ($30\text{ Hz}$ to $30\text{ kHz}$)**: Equipment shall not exhibit malfunction or performance degradation beyond tolerances when subjected to magnetic fields in Figure 20 (MIL-STD-461, Section 6.12 Limits for RE02.-, p. 18).
* **RS02 and (T) RS04**:
  * **Power Frequency Test**: Equipment shall withstand $20\text{ A}$ applied to the test wire at power frequency(ies) (MIL-STD-461, Section 6.12 Limits for RE02.-, p. 18).
  * **Spike Test**: Equipment shall withstand Figure 19 spike shapes where $E = 100\text{ V}$ across $5\,\Omega$ applied to the test wire (MIL-STD-461, Section 6.12 Limits for RE02.-, p. 18).
* **RS03 ($14\text{ kHz}$ to $10\text{ GHz}$)**: No malfunction, degradation of performance, or deviation beyond tolerances shall occur when subjected to a radiated field of $1\text{ V/m}$ (MIL-STD-461, Section 6.12 Limits for RE02.-, p. 18).

*(Note: The retrieved sections of MIL-STD-461 do not cover specific Conducted Emission [CE] limits such as CE01–CE06).*

question: MIL-STD-1586A hangi güvenlik konfigürasyonlarını gerektirir?
answer:
Getirilen standart metinlerine dayanarak yapılan inceleme sonuçları aşağıdadır:

### MIL-STD-1586A Kapsamı ve İçeriği
1. **Standart Unvanı ve Amacı**: MIL-STD-1586A, *"Quality Program Requirements for Space and Launch Vehicles"* (Uzay ve Fırlatma Araçları İçin Kalite Programı Gereksinimleri) başlıklı bir askeri standarttır (MIL-STD-1586A, p. 38). Amacı, uzay ve fırlatma araçlarına yönelik özel kalite programı gereksinimlerini belirlemek ve MIL-Q-9858 standardını tamamlamaktır (MIL-STD-1586A, Section 1.1, p. 9; FOREWORD, p. 3-5).
2. **Kapsadığı Alanlar**: Standart; imalat ve test planlaması, işçilik standartları, izlenebilirlik, veri paketleri, ölçüm ve test ekipmanlarının kalibrasyonu (MIL-STD-45662 uyarınca), elektrostatik deşarj kontrolü (ESD), temizlik/kontaminasyon/korozyon kontrolü ve uygun olmayan malzeme yönetimi gibi kalite güvence süreçlerini kapsar (MIL-STD-1586A, Section 4.3.3, p. 24; Section 4.5.1, p. 25-26; CONTENTS, p. 6-8).

### Güvenlik Konfigürasyonları Değerlendirmesi
Erişilen metin kesitlerinde, IT/siber güvenlik anlamında herhangi bir **"güvenlik konfigürasyonu" (security configuration)** gereksinimi yer almamaktadır. Standart, bilgi güvenliği veya siber güvenlik yapılandırmalarını değil, donanım imalatı ve uzay sistemlerinin kalite kontrol süreçlerini düzenlemektedir.
